# Stack & grid (`stack`)

Stack, row and responsive card grid.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createCard` (types in `dist/web/data-display/card.d.ts`): `.mh-card`: a surface with `--mh-surface`, the panel outline, `--mh-radius-lg` and `--mh-shadow-1`. Parts `__media`, `__header` (`__icon`, `__heading` with `__eyebrow`, `__title`, `__subtitle`; `__action`), `__body`, `__footer`. Variants `--flat`, `--inset`; `--interactive` when the whole card is pressable, as a `role="button"` or, with `href`, as an `<a>`.

```ts
export function createCard(options: CardOptions = {}): CardHandle;

export interface CardOptions {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A small line above the title ("Source · 2 h ago"). */
  eyebrow?: string;
  /** Clamps the title to this many lines. */
  titleLines?: ClampLines;
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** An element at the end of the header (an icon button, a badge, a switch). */
  headerAction?: HTMLElement;
  /** Edge-to-edge media at the top (an `<img>`), shown 16:9 and cropped to cover. */
  media?: HTMLElement;
  /** Width / height of the media (default 16 / 9); a wider one (2 or 2.4) keeps pictures short in a list or carousel. */
  mediaAspect?: number;
  /** Body content. */
  body?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons). */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** `raised` (default) lifts off the canvas with `--mh-shadow-1`; `flat` has no shadow; `inset` sits in a well. */
  variant?: CardVariant;
  /** The whole card is one link (`<a href>`). Don't put other links or buttons inside. */
  href?: string;
  /** Link target; `_blank` also sets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. */
  target?: string;
  /** The whole card is one pressable target (`role="button"`, Enter and Space); with `href`, a click listener on the link. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;
  /** Accessible name of a pressable card (default: its text). */
  label?: string;
  /** Heading level of the title (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
}

export interface CardHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The body element, to append content later. */
  body: HTMLDivElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string): void;
}
```

`createGrid` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): `.mh-grid`: a responsive card grid (`--sm | --lg` minimum column, `--gap-<step>`).

```ts
export function createGrid(options: GridOptions = {}, ...children: Child[]):;

export interface GridOptions {
  /** Minimum column width; columns fill the row (default `medium`). Follows the touch-target size. */
  min?: GridMin;
  gap?: Space;
  as?: 'div' | 'section' | 'ul' | 'ol';
}
```

`createRow` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): Shorthand for a row stack, centred on the cross axis.

```ts
export function createRow(options: Omit<StackOptions, 'direction'> = {}, ...children: Child[]):;

export interface StackOptions {
  /** `column` (default) or `row`. */
  direction?: 'column' | 'row';
  gap?: Space;
  align?: StackAlign;
  justify?: StackJustify;
  /** Rows wrap onto more lines. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  /** Element to render (default `div`). */
  as?: 'div' | 'section' | 'ul' | 'ol' | 'nav' | 'header' | 'footer';
}
```

`createStack` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): `.mh-stack`: children in a column or (`--row`) a row, spaced by `--mh-space-*` (`--gap-<step>`, default `md`).

```ts
export function createStack(options: StackOptions = {}, ...children: Child[]):;
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createCard, createGrid, createRow, createStack, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Office'];
const grid = createGrid({ min: 'small', gap: 'sm' }, ...rooms.map((title) => createCard({ title }).el));

const addRoom = createButton({
  label: 'Add room',
  icon: 'add',
  variant: 'secondary',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => grid.el.append(createCard({ title: `Room ${grid.el.children.length + 1}` }).el),
});

const page = createStack(
  { gap: 'lg' },
  createRow({ justify: 'between' }, createText('Rooms', { variant: 'title' }), addRoom.el).el,
  grid.el,
);

document.body.append(page.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Grid, Row, Stack, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function StackExample() {
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState(['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Office']);
  const addRoom = () => setRooms((list) => [...list, `Room ${list.length + 1}`]);
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Row justify="between">
        <Text variant="title">Rooms</Text>
        <Button icon="add" variant="secondary" size="small" onClick={addRoom}>
          Add room
        </Button>
      </Row>
      <Grid min="small" gap="sm">
        {rooms.map((room) => (
          <Card key={room} title={room} />
        ))}
      </Grid>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```
